title: Apple iPhone Duo Shortage Could Continue Through Christmas as Delivery Delays Reach 2027
shortdescription: Apple's first foldable iPhone has sold out following strong demand, but the company cannot predict when supplies will recover as component shortages and rising memory costs complicate production.
